refactor(diff-source): let one subscription keep source views in sync

markdown$ already flows into markdownSourceEditorValue$, which the plugin
dispatches into the mounted CodeMirror view. The DiffViewer subscription
replaced the whole document a second time, and SourceEditor rebuilt its view
on every markdown$ change, discarding the selection and history the new
handoff logic preserves.
